description: Only transactions with an amount strictly greater than 2400 count, so an amount of exactly 2400 is excluded.

d.request: Among the 10 accounts with the most transactions where trans.amount > 2400 (strictly greater; amounts equal to 2400 excluded), list each account's trans.account_id, the average trans.amount of those large transactions, and their count, ordered by count descending.
d.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY txn_count DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: Among the 10 accounts with the most transactions where trans.amount > 2400 (strictly greater, excluding exactly 2400), show account_id, the average trans.amount of those large transactions, and their count, sorted by count descending.
b.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY trans_count DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: Among the 10 accounts with the most transactions where trans.amount > 2400 (strictly greater, excluding exactly 2400), show account_id, the average trans.amount of those large transactions, and their count, sorted by count descending.

c.request: Treating 2400 as the cutoff for a large transaction amount (`trans.amount`), which 10 accounts (`trans.account_id`) have the most large transactions? For each one, show the account ID, the average amount of its large transactions, and how many it has, sorted by that count from highest to lowest. Only transactions with an amount strictly greater than 2400 count, so an amount of exactly 2400 is excluded.
c.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_large_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY large_transaction_count DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

a.request: Considering only transactions whose amount (`trans.amount`) is greater than 2400, group them by account (`trans.account_id`) and, for each account, show the account ID, the average transaction amount, and the number of such transactions. Sort the accounts by that number of transactions from highest to lowest and return only the first 10.
a.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10;
